name: Vinylla
intro: [happy] You came all this way for the release? I’m touched. Truly.
One turn of the press and the sun is a record. Gold on one side, darkness on the other.
[angry] And every one of them will pay to listen.
[happy] This is the last track, darling. Make it count.
win: “No... the press. It’s stopped. Who let all that gold in here?”
hint: Vinylla waits at the press under the Inner Sun with six Billies, level 64–67.
endLines: [sad] Gold. Everywhere. On the floor, on the press, on the record...
[happy] Aurumansa. The golden caravan. It always comes when something is about to get rare.
Look at it, Vinylla. Gold all over the pressing floor. Nothing here is limited any more.
[angry] Do you know what a record is worth if everyone can have one?
[happy] About what it’s worth to listen to it. Turns out that was the point.
And you. You were the sound engineer on her tour. You read the plans, and Cass made sure you fell.
[happy] Welcome back. The sun is still up. It will be up tomorrow too.
